name: Steve Foster
source:
Steve is [url=/c148358]Kara[/url]’s ex-husband and [url=/c148359]Ian[/url]’s father. After the end of their marriage, Steve refuses to let go and promises to make her life hell if he can’t see his son. His anger is only fueled as he sees [url=/c148291]MC[/url] around his family more and more often.
